code_loss: mean teacher-forced code CE over three levels
early_targets: frozen oracle-prefix decoder distributions, KL averaged over digits
final_target: true four digits, mean cross entropy
rollout: hard argmax forward, softmax straight-through backward, generated earlier embeddings
initialization: identical fresh predictor and event positions in both arms
budget: equal epochs and optimizer updates; both arms execute the auxiliary forward path
selection: fixed final epoch, no test selection
